summary: Script has strong bash practices (set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, error handling to stderr) and workflow uses appropriate triggers/permissions. However, deliverable is incomplete: workflow references nonexistent fixtures/mixed_change.txt, rules.conf, and tests/label_assigner.bats but doesn't create them. The assign-labels job will fail immediately trying to read missing files. Glob matching logic is correct but comment about '**' translation is misleading (no translation actually occurs). Critical blocker: task requires 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' and generate act-result.txt—impossible without fixture files. Missing test file means bats step (line 21) will fail. RULES_FILE env var set (line 7) but file never created.
